title: Flow Cytometry Protocol for Human and Mouse CTLA-4 Detection
author: abinScience cheng

steps.title: Cell isolation and activation
steps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs from whole blood by density‑gradient centrifugation using Ficoll‑Paque at 400 × g for 30 min. For activated human T cells, stimulate the PBMCs with either anti‑CD3/CD28 beads or plate‑bound anti‑CD3 (1 µg/mL) plus soluble anti‑CD28 (2 µg/mL) for 48–72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. For Treg intracellular analysis, activation is not required; use freshly isolated PBMCs directly. Harvest cells, wash once with PBS and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min. Resuspend in FACS buffer (PBS + 2 % FBS + 0.05 % sodium azide) at 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL and aliquot 100 µL (1 × 10⁶ cells) per well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate. For mouse samples, harvest splenocytes or lymph‑node cells, pass through a 70 µm cell strainer, and for activation stimulate with anti‑CD3ε (clone 145‑2C11, 1 µg/mL) plus anti‑CD28 (clone 37.51, 2 µg/mL) for 48 h. Note that CTLA‑4 surface expression peaks at 48–72 h post‑activation and is rapidly internalized.

substeps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs by Ficoll‑Paque centrifugation (400 × g, 30 min).
Activate human T cells with anti‑CD3 (1 µg/mL) + anti‑CD28 (2 µg/mL) for 48–72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (or use beads).
For Treg intracellular staining, skip activation and use fresh PBMCs.
Harvest cells, wash with PBS, centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min.
Resuspend in PBS + 2 % FBS + 0.05 % sodium azide at 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL.
Aliquot 100 µL (1 × 10⁶ cells) into each well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.
For mouse: prepare single‑cell suspension through 70 µm strainer; activate with anti‑CD3ε (1 µg/mL) + anti‑CD28 (2 µg/mL) for 48 h.

steps.title: Fixable viability staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant. Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL PBS containing a fixable viability dye according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Incubate at room temperature for 15 min protected from light, then wash once with FACS buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 100 µL PBS + fixable viability dye (per manufacturer).
Incubate RT 15 min, protected from light.
Wash once with FACS buffer.

steps.title: Fc receptor blocking
steps.instruction: For human samples, resuspend cells in 50 µL FACS buffer containing human Fc block (5 µL per test) and incubate at room temperature for 10 min without washing. For mouse samples, resuspend in 50 µL FACS buffer containing anti‑mouse CD16/CD32 Fc block (AbinScience InVivoMAb Mouse Anti‑Mouse CD16/CD32, Cat# MP551010) and incubate at 4 °C for 10 min without washing.

substeps.instruction: Human: add 5 µL human Fc block to 50 µL cells, RT 10 min, no wash.
Mouse: add anti‑mouse CD16/CD32 (Cat# MP551010) to 50 µL cells, 4 °C 10 min, no wash.

steps.title: Surface antibody staining
steps.instruction: Add fluorochrome‑conjugated anti‑CTLA‑4 antibody at the concentration recommended on the datasheet (human clone 11.2.1 FITC Cat# HB651217, PE Cat# HB651227, or APC Cat# HB651237; mouse clone 9D9 FITC Cat# MB651217, PE Cat# MB651227, or APC Cat# MB651237). Co‑stain simultaneously with lineage markers (anti‑CD3, anti‑CD4, anti‑CD25) as required for Treg identification. Incubate at 4 °C for 30 min protected from light. Wash twice with 200 µL FACS buffer, centrifuging at 300 × g for 5 min each wash. If only surface CTLA‑4 is needed, proceed to acquisition; otherwise continue to fixation/permeabilization.

substeps.instruction: Add anti‑CTLA‑4 antibody (human 11.2.1 or mouse 9D9) at datasheet concentration.
Add lineage antibodies (anti‑CD3, anti‑CD4, anti‑CD25).
Incubate 4 °C 30 min, protected from light.
Wash twice with 200 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge 300 × g 5 min each.

steps.title: Fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: After surface staining (or directly after Fc block if surface staining is omitted), fix cells in 200 µL fixation buffer containing 2–4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS at 4 °C for 20 min. Wash once with FACS buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min. Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL permeabilization buffer (0.1 % saponin in FACS buffer or a commercial perm buffer), centrifuge, and finally resuspend in 100 µL permeabilization buffer. Note: for combined FoxP3 + CTLA‑4 staining, use a FoxP3/Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Set; PE and APC fluorophores remain bright after fixation, FITC is compatible, while PerCP may lose signal.

substeps.instruction: Fix in 200 µL 2–4 % PFA/PBS at 4 °C 20 min.
Wash once with FACS buffer, centrifuge 300 × g 5 min.
Resuspend in 200 µL 0.1 % saponin permeabilization buffer.
Centrifuge and resuspend in 100 µL permeabilization buffer.

steps.title: Intracellular CTLA-4 staining
steps.instruction: Add fluorochrome‑conjugated anti‑CTLA‑4 antibody (different fluorochrome from any surface antibody used) in permeabilization buffer at the concentration recommended on the datasheet. Recommended options: human 11.2.1 PE Cat# HB651227 or APC Cat# HB651237; mouse 9D9 PE Cat# MB651227 or APC Cat# MB651237. Unconjugated alternatives (requiring a fluorochrome‑conjugated secondary) include anti‑human CD152/CTLA‑4 (Cat# HB651207) or research‑grade Ipilimumab (Cat# HB651016). Incubate at room temperature for 30 min in the dark. Wash twice with permeabilization buffer (saponin‑based, not regular FACS buffer). Resuspend the final pellet in 200 µL FACS buffer for acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Add anti‑CTLA‑4 antibody (different fluorochrome from surface) in permeabilization buffer at datasheet concentration.
Incubate RT 30 min, protected from light.
Wash twice with permeabilization buffer (0.1 % saponin).
Resuspend in 200 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Data acquisition and analysis
steps.instruction: Acquire at least 10 000 events within the CD3⁺ T‑cell gate (or ≥50 000 total events for rare Treg populations) on a flow cytometer. Apply the following gating hierarchy: FSC/SSC → singlets (FSC‑A vs FSC‑H) → viable cells → CD3⁺ → CD4⁺ or CD8⁺. For Tregs, gate CD3⁺ → CD4⁺ → CD25^high → FoxP3⁺ → CTLA‑4⁺; for activated T cells, gate CD3⁺ → CD4⁺ → CTLA‑4⁺. Include appropriate controls: isotype or FMO for CTLA‑4, unstimulated T cells as a biological negative control, and stimulated T cells as a positive control. Expected results: surface CTLA‑4 <5 % on resting T cells, 20–60 % on CD4⁺ T cells after 48–72 h stimulation; intracellular CTLA‑4 80–95 % of CD4⁺ CD25^high FoxP3⁺ Tregs and 10–30 % of resting conventional CD4⁺ T cells. Mouse patterns are analogous; clone 9D9 detects both surface and intracellular CTLA‑4. For in‑vivo blocking studies, consider AbinScience InVivo Plus Anti‑Mouse CD152/CTLA‑4 (9D9) Cat# MB651209.

substeps.instruction: Acquire ≥10 000 CD3⁺ events (≥50 000 for rare Tregs).
Gate: FSC/SSC → singlets → viable → CD3⁺ → CD4⁺/CD8⁺ (or Treg hierarchy).
Run isotype/FMO, unstimulated, and stimulated controls.
Interpret percentages according to expected ranges.
